subject: Banking
title: The People's Bank of China
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The People's Bank of China.

hook.text: China's central bank controls the world's second-largest economy.

buildup.text: The PBOC manages interest rates, reserve requirements, and the yuan's exchange rate.

discovery.text: The PBOC uses 'window guidance': informal instructions to banks about how much to lend and to whom.

twist.text: China's managed exchange rate keeps the yuan artificially competitive.

climax.text: China's central bank is the most interventionist in the world.

punchline.text: Party-controlled central bank. China manages money supply, lending.

quiz.question: How much does the PBOC hold in foreign reserves?
